extracted.stage: Pre-grant; inheritance tax due before grant of probate
extracted.summary: A solicitor administering a £757k St Albans estate, mostly the deceased's home with little cash, asks for £28k to pay inheritance tax before the grant can issue.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding the inheritance tax on this estate, which we have passed to our underwriting team. To take matters forward we would need confirmation of the executors' details, a copy of the will and the death certificate, a schedule of the estate's assets and liabilities, and confirmation of any existing charges over the property. It would also help to have the IHT400 figures and any date by which the tax payment is required. We will be in touch once we have reviewed the information provided, and nothing in this message constitutes an offer of finance or confirmation that funding is available.
